messages.en: I just watched a documentary about hunters on TV.
Oh, the one where they follow hunters tracking deer? I only caught a bit of it.
Have they announced the lucky draw winners yet?
Yeah! Hey, your name's on the list of winners!
Has the owner of that house replied to your message yet?
Yeah, he said we can only view the house this afternoon.
Do you think Nadia would make a good team leader for us?
Definitely. She's got experience managing projects—she's not all talk.
